headline: BLS E-Services subsidiary sells JLG business for ₹59.49 lakh
summary: Atyati Technologies, a BLS E-Services subsidiary, approved the slump sale of its JLG lending unit to TVAM Technologies. The deal involves a consideration of ₹59.49 lakh.

headline: SBI Funds appoints Giridhar Sanjeevi as independent director
summary: SBI Funds Management Limited appointed Giridhar Sanjeevi as an additional independent director for three years, effective September 29, 2026, following Moiz Miyajiwala's term completion.

headline: Marine Electricals bags Rs 250.78 cr order
summary: Marine Electricals wins Rs 250.78 crore order for power distribution systems from Marine Electricals (India) Limited. Execution period is 10-12 months.

headline: Adani Ports settles SEBI probe for ₹37 lakh
summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited received a SEBI settlement order regarding alleged listing regulation violations. The company and five directors agreed to pay ₹37,05,000 without admitting guilt.

headline: Adani Power settles SEBI case for ₹37.05 lakh
summary: Adani Power and three directors settled SEBI proceedings for ₹37.05 lakh regarding listing regulation violations. The company stated there is no material financial impact.

headline: Supreme Engg wins Rs 5.29 cr supply order from MHI
summary: Supreme Engineering secured a Rs 5.29 crore work order for superalloy supply. The order represents ~2.5x quarterly revenue but faces execution risks given negative ROCE and TTM net losses.

headline: GE Shipping to acquire 157,000 DWT Suezmax tanker
summary: GE Shipping plans to acquire a new-building 157,000 DWT Suezmax tanker, with delivery expected in H2FY29, expanding its fleet capacity.

headline: Stocks to Watch: NCC, Ellenbarrie, Power Mech in focus
summary: NCC bags ₹1,076 Cr AP order; Ellenbarrie wins ₹961 Cr BHEL deals. Power Mech Q1 profit up 11%. Check key moves.

headline: Tata Motors subsidiary buys 26% stake in Mateshwari E-Smart
summary: A Tata Motors subsidiary has acquired a 26% stake in Mateshwari E-Smart Mobility, marking its entry into electric bus operations and maintenance services.

headline: Axiscades Tech: ~21.65 lakh shares change hands at ₹1,824
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 21,65,572 Axiscades Tech shares at ₹1,824 per share on NSE, totalling ₹395 crore, during the pre-open session.

headline: Jefferies flags mixed telecom trends in August
summary: Jefferies noted improved mobile subscriber additions in August, with Bharti's active subscribers falling 0.1mn vs +0.3mn in July. Vi's active user losses moderated, while home broadband outpaced mobile net adds.

headline: Jefferies sees 10% CAGR for India's fan market
summary: India's ~90% penetrated fan market is seen growing ~10% CAGR over FY26–31E, with BLDC fans at 30% CAGR. Crompton targets 100 bps market-share gain; Havells' BLDC fans were ~40% of ceiling-fan offerings in FY26.

headline: Prasol Chemicals targets ₹2,800-3,000 crore revenue in 5 years
summary: Prasol Chemicals has expressed an aspiration to achieve revenue of ₹2,800 to ₹3,000 crore over the next five years, signalling long-term growth ambitions for the chemical company.

headline: Indian pharma sector eyes ~10% growth in FY27
summary: India's pharma sector is projected to grow ~10% in FY27, supported by domestic demand, CDMO activity, and API recovery, even as US market pressure persists.

headline: Pulse prices jump up to 10% in a month
summary: Pulse prices have risen up to 10% in a month as drought-hit supplies and festive demand tighten the market, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Honasa shares worth ₹611.18 crore change hands
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,34,91,940 Honasa Consumer shares changing hands on NSE at ₹453.00 per share, totalling ₹611.18 crore.

headline: HDFC Bank block trade of ₹43.14 crore on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 6,05,234 shares of HDFC Bank was executed on the NSE at ₹712.85 per share, totalling ₹43.14 crore.

headline: HDFC Bank shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 8,03,720 HDFC Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹707.25, with combined value of ₹56.84 crore.

headline: Delhivery shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 500,372 Delhivery shares changing hands on BSE at ₹414.50, with a combined value of ₹20.74 crore.

headline: Premier Energies flags margin pressure in coming quarters
summary: Premier Energies expects market pain and pressure on margins in upcoming quarters, as indicated in a recent interview with company management.

headline: Transformers & Rectifiers passes QIP resolution
summary: Shareholders approved variation in QIP proceeds utilisation with 99.99% votes in favour. The special resolution was passed on September 28, 2026.

headline: LIC of India shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 5,09,854 shares of LIC of India changing hands at ₹396.95 on NSE, with combined value of ₹20.24 crore.

headline: Coal India ED Contracts relinquishes charge
summary: Dr. Anjani Kumar relinquished charge as Executive Director (Contracts) at Coal India on September 28, 2026, following his appointment as Director (Tech) at Western Coalfields Limited.

headline: Varmora Granito lists above issue price on BSE
summary: Varmora Granito made its stock market debut on BSE at ₹152, a premium over its issue price of ₹148, marking a positive listing for the company.

headline: Punjab Chemicals closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Punjab Chemicals & Crop Protection Ltd has closed its trading window effective October 1, 2026, ahead of Q2FY27 results. Insiders are barred from trading until 48 hours post-declaration.

headline: Paisalo Digital promoter releases 30 lakh shares
summary: Equilibrated Venture Cflow, a promoter group entity of Paisalo Digital, released a pledge on 30,00,000 shares dated September 28, 2026.

headline: Vinati Organics expects ATBS demand rise in December
summary: Vinati Organics anticipates a rise in demand for ATBS in December, with the rupee's decline expected to boost revenue for the specialty chemicals company.

headline: ICICI Lombard targets 17-20% RoE via digital moat
summary: ICICI Lombard outlines strategy to sustain 17-20% RoE through digital transformation, targeting 90%+ digital servicing and 5% retention improvement by FY29.

headline: Lodha targets ₹4,100-4,200 crore PAT in FY27
summary: Lodha aims for ₹4,100-4,200 crore PAT in FY27 and plans ₹10,000-11,000 crore investment in a 1 GW data centre, targeting ₹2,000-2,500 crore yearly rental income by FY32.

headline: ICICI Lombard shares video links for Digital Day Meet 2026
summary: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited disclosed video links for its Digital Day Meet 2026 presentation to BSE and NSE on September 29, 2026.

headline: Sri Ramakrishna Mills holds 79th AGM, passes all resolutions
summary: Sri Ramakrishna Mills (Coimbatore) Ltd concluded its 79th AGM on September 28, 2026. All resolutions, including director reappointments and adoption of FY26 financials, were passed.

headline: GE Vernova T&D shares flag large trade on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,89,798 shares of GE Vernova T&D changing hands on BSE at ₹4,180.00, with a combined value of ₹121.14 crore.

headline: Amber Enterprises closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: Amber Enterprises India Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after declaring Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: Pine Labs extends five-year tech deal with Woolworths
summary: Pine Labs has extended its technology partnership with Woolworths Group for five years, reinforcing its presence in the retail payments and technology solutions space.

headline: Varmora Granito launches lab-grown marbles, eyes higher GVT share
summary: Varmora Granito has introduced lab-grown marbles and projects GVT to constitute 95% of sales this year, up from 84% last year.

headline: India to launch National Steel Policy soon
summary: India's Steel Secretary announced the National Steel Policy will open for public comments next week. Construction and automotive sectors identified as key consumers by 2047.

headline: Tata Consumer Products shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 158,869 shares of Tata Consumer Products on NSE, valued at ₹15.27 crore, at a price of ₹961.10 per share.

headline: Axiscades Engineering shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,35,057 Axiscades Engineering shares changing hands on NSE at ₹2,011.50 per share, with combined value of ₹27.17 crore.

headline: India Steel Secy: Consumption outpaces capacity
summary: India's Steel Secretary states that steel consumption is growing faster than production capacity. The ministry is actively collaborating with international partners to secure raw materials and advanced technology for the sector.

headline: Symbiotec Pharmalab gets VAI status from U.S. FDA
summary: Symbiotec Pharmalab received the U.S. FDA Establishment Inspection Report for its Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh facility with Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) status.
